channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: McGuinness remains hopeful of facing Down in Ballybofey
item.description: Jim McGuinness believes Donegal's Ulster SFC quarter-final against Down could still take place in MacCumhaill Park.

item.title: No NFL game in Croker this year
item.description: American football won't be returning to Croke Park in 2026, NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell has confirmed.

item.title: McConville calls for level playing field after controversial defeat
item.description: Oisín McConville has claimed the GAA is paying lip service to teams outside the top two divisions in the Allianz Football League with regard to the new playing rules.

item.title: Ballygunner contingent ready for Waterford return
item.description: Waterford manager Peter Queally expects to have his Ballygunner contingent back for next Sunday's Allianz Hurling League Division 1A clash with Offaly.

item.title: Brady back in charge of Edenderry
item.description: Peter Brady and Greg Farrelly have been appointed as the new joint-managers of the Edenderry senior football team.

item.title: Derry GAA secures naming rights for main grounds
item.description: Derry GAA has struck an agreement with local company Find Insurance for the naming rights of both Celtic Park and the Owenbeg Centre of Excellence.

item.title: Former club chairperson makes Longford return after long absence
item.description: Longford belatedly opened their Allianz Football League Division 4 campaign with a first-ever defeat to London last Sunday.

item.title: Fitzgibbon and Sigerson Cup semi-finals down for decision
item.description: It's a huge week in third-level colleges hurling and football with the Fitzgibbon and Sigerson Cup semi-finals taking place.

item.title: Cork-Tipp clash to draw bumper crowd
item.description: A crowd of around 25,000 is expected to descend on SuperValu Páirc Uí Chaoimh for Saturday evening's glamour Allianz Hurling League Division 1A clash between Cork and Tipperary.

item.title: 'He needs to be careful'
item.description: Ciarán Whelan has called for patience in Dublin as Ger Brennan strives to strike the right balance between youth and experience.
